title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Opinion Essay on Oral English Assessment
prompt: In some countries, the speaking component of English language examinations is assessed through a single face-to-face interview, while in others it is evaluated through multiple recorded tasks completed over several days. Some educators argue that a single interview is sufficient to measure a candidate's oral proficiency, whereas others believe that multiple assessments provide a more reliable picture. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请针对题目要求，讨论双方观点并给出你自己的看法。建议先规划文章结构，确保清晰表达立场，并用具体理由和例子支持论点。注意字数不少于250词。
